securityDefectsFoundAndFixed.defect: generateAnonymousVoterId() embedded Date.now() in its HMAC input, making voterId non-deterministic across calls and silently defeating the 'already voted' duplicate-vote check on every cast — a member could vote unlimited times
securityDefectsFoundAndFixed.fix: derive voterId deterministically from (memberId, sessionId) only

securityDefectsFoundAndFixed.defect: app/api/governance/elections/sessions/[id]/vote/route.ts accepted a client-supplied voterId and never checked voter_eligibility at all, letting a caller impersonate/duplicate ballots
securityDefectsFoundAndFixed.fix: delegate to the same castVote() (server-derived voterId + real eligibility check) already used by app/api/voting/sessions/[id]/vote/route.ts

securityDefectsFoundAndFixed.defect: no DB-level uniqueness prevented a concurrent-request race from double-inserting a vote for the same (session, voter)
securityDefectsFoundAndFixed.test: covered by manifest invariant + composition tests

securityDefectsFoundAndFixed.defect: services/financial-service/src/routes/payments.ts's donation endpoints derived organizationId via `getAuthUser(req).organizationId || req.body.organizationId` — an unauthenticated public donor could supply an arbitrary organizationId, misattributing a donation to any organization
securityDefectsFoundAndFixed.fix: derive organizationId server-side from the strike fund's own tenantId (createDonationPaymentIntent) and from the Stripe payment intent's own metadata (confirmDonationPayment) — never client-suppliable

securityDefectsFoundAndFixed.defect: round-46 documented PRINCIPAL_MISMATCH: services/platform-economics/transaction-fee-engine.ts's evaluateFee/captureTransactionFee/reverseTransactionFee execute on the plain tenant `db` import despite being invoked from a WEBHOOK context
